entities.name: Cinder Marsh
entities.description: Nasty area of sludge and ash on Rath where the Stronghold's furnaces exhausted.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Fortress at the Hub, reached through the Cinder Marsh exhaust vents.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that passed through the Cinder Marsh.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures that swarmed the Weatherlight crew in the Stronghold's depths.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay

events.summary: The Weatherlight enters an inactive exhaust vent and is swarmed by slivers.
